svg.text: I²C temperature telemetry, RGB status outputs and PWM magnetic buzzer
34 × 34 mm | 4-layer PCB | Unrouted V2 draft — NOT FOR FABRICATION
Common anode uses programming USB 5 V
3.3 V gates; 10k external pull-downs keep RGB off during reset.
100 mA magnetic load; 4 kHz target; MOSFET and flyback diode
3.3 V rail present; RGB/buzzer require firmware
